turn.user_message: Which part saves the most time?
turn.context: Playbook §6: the answer checked against the real times Diagnosis collected.

text: No single part. The wait is five knots, and most need two parts to undo them.
Parts 1 and 2 together undo three of the five. Add Part 3 and Part 4, and the last two come undone.
chat.pointer: Pick parts on the rope drawing to see which knots they undo. Pick a knot for its detail.
chat.note: No part works alone. Most knots need two hands.

blocks.title: Five knots in one wait
blocks.deck: Your real times, from ready to leaving and the empty bed after. Each knot is held by one or two parts.

segments.name: Waiting for the summary
segments.today: The summary is typed next morning, then waits for the doctor to sign.

how.how: Drafts the summary from notes already in your files
The doctor signs an early summary on the evening round

segments.name: Waiting for the bill
segments.today: The bill is drawn up only after the signature.

how.how: Adds each charge to the bill as it happens
Billing agrees to check the bill, not build it

segments.name: Waiting for insurance
segments.today: The insurer is asked only once the bill is final.

how.how: Sends an early request the evening before

segments.name: Final checks and the family
segments.today: Medicines are packed and the family called only at the end.

how.how: Medicines listed and the family told on the evening round

segments.name: The empty bed
segments.today: Housekeeping hears late, so the bed stays empty 75 minutes.

how.how: Housekeeping hears the moment the patient leaves
One person owns the bed until the next patient

blocks.condition: Part 5 undoes no knot. It measures every one. How much each knot shrinks is not yet measured here.
